name: Healing Touch
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level adept 1, bard 1, cleric/oracle 1, druid 1, paladin 1, ranger 2, shaman 1, white necromancer 1, witch 1
Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S
Range touch
Target one living creature
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fortitude half (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

You hold your touch on the target and their wounds begin to mend.

Each round that you touch a target you heal them 1d2 + 1 per two caster levels (maximum +2).

This spell cannot be used to harm undead. Each round while concentrating on the spell, you may change who you are touching for this spell.

Healing Touch

School conjuration (healing); Level adept 3, bard 3, cleric/oracle 3, druid 4, paladin 3, ranger 4, shaman 3, white necromancer 3, witch 3

This spell functions as lesser healing touch except that the amount healed is 1d6 + 1 per caster level (max +10).

Healing Touch, Greater

School conjuration (healing); Level adept 5, bard 5, cleric/oracle 5, druid 6, paladin 4, shaman 5, white necromancer 5, witch 5

This spell functions as lesser healing touch except that the amount healed is 1d8 + 1 per caster level (max +15).
